title: Hawaiian Sunset — Cartoon Style
author: pixel
task: Generate a cartoon image of a Hawaiian sunset
prompt: A vibrant cartoon-style Hawaiian sunset scene. The sky is a dramatic gradient of deep orange, hot pink, purple, and golden yellow. A large, stylized sun sinks toward a calm ocean horizon. Silhouetted palm trees with chunky cartoon fronds frame the foreground. A wooden beach hut and surfboards lean against the palms. Tropical flowers like hibiscus in red and pink dot the foreground. Cartoon-style puffy clouds glow in warm sunset hues. The ocean reflects shimmering golden-orange light with gentle cartoon waves. Bold outlines, rich saturated colors, Disney/Pixar-inspired illustration style.
